records.title: Development work of National Waterway-5 In Odisha.
details: a to c): The Detailed Project Report (DPR) for National Waterway (NW)-5 is under finalization.

records.title: Riverine or Inland Port Development in Kendrapara
details:
a to d: the Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), an autonomous
organisation under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways has prepared a project report for development of National Waterway-5 (Talcher- Dhamra Stretch of Brahmani- Kharsua-Tantighai-Pandua Nala-Dudhei Nala-Kani Dhamra-river system) for evacuation of Coal through Talcher Coalfields which passes through Kendrapara District.

records.title: Launched by NSIL
details: c: has signed a contract with M/s HAL (Lead partner of HAL and L&T consortium) for End-to-End manufacturing of 5 nos of Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV). The 1st fully Indian Industry manufactured PSLV would be launched during 2nd half of 2025.

records.title: MY BHARAT PORTAL
details: a to b: As the MY Bharat Portal has been newly launched in October, 2023 only, assessment of the impact of the portal in terms of its effectiveness in empowering youth is yet to be made.

records.title: Bio-AI Hubs
details: d: Further plans for setting up of Bio-AI hubs and Biomanufacturing facilities are also under process.
